answer: Ephemeral Challenge Ledge: each identity must solve a fresh, instance-bound cipher derived from the previous block's pulse before submitting any action; valid solutions are consumed on use and never repeat. Because every challenge is unique to the requester's live state, solutions cannot be transferred or stockpiled. An attacker mass-producing identities must pay a distinct compute cost per identity per action, making sustained sybil operation linearly expensive rather than a one-time fee.
